map.根据肺量计测定数据计算 FEV1/FVC 比值，判读通气功能障碍类型及 GOLD: Computes the FEV1/FVC ratio from spirometry data to classify ventilatory defect type and GOLD severity
map.📖 查看「肺功能 FEV1/FVC 分级器 使用指南」: 📖 View the Pulmonary Function FEV1/FVC Grader user guide
map.自定义阈值 / LLN（留空则用左侧下拉）: Custom cutoff / LLN (blank = use the dropdown)
map.FEV1/FVC ≥ 阈值 且 FVC ≥ 80%预计 且 FEV1 ≥ 80%: FEV1/FVC >= threshold, FVC >= 80% predicted and FEV1 >= 80% predicted
map.FEV1 占预计值降低（未达阻塞/限制判据）: FEV1 percent predicted reduced (no obstruction/restriction criteria met)
map.一秒率与 FVC 均不低于阈值，但 FEV1 占预计值 <80%，不符合「通气功: Both the ratio and FVC are at or above threshold, but FEV1 % predicted is <80%, so the three-parameter normal criteria are not met. Correlate with symptoms, DLCO and follow-up; this page does not conclude obstruction or restriction (estimate only, clinical review required).
map.需TLC确认，见于肺纤维化/胸壁疾病: Needs TLC confirmation; seen in pulmonary fibrosis / chest wall disease
map.📊 GOLD 阻塞性气流受限严重度（基于 FEV1%预计值）: 📊 GOLD Severity of Obstructive Airflow Limitation (based on FEV1% predicted)
map.提示：FEV1/FVC 固定阈值 0.70 对年轻人可能高估、对老年人可能低估阻: Note: the fixed 0.70 FEV1/FVC cutoff may overestimate obstruction in the young and underestimate it in the elderly; interpret together with LLN (lower limit of normal). Restrictive defects need TLC confirmation. Post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC <0.70 indicates incompletely reversible airflow limitation (COPD). Clinical reference only.
map.比值=1.5/3.0=50%<0.7→阻塞性；FVC%pred≥80 不支持限制: Ratio = 1.5/3.0 = 50% < 0.7 -> obstructive; FVC%pred >=80 does not support restriction.
map.比值正常但 FVC%pred<80→限制性通气障碍，查 TLC。: Normal ratio but FVC%pred <80 -> restrictive defect; check TLC.
map.本工具 cutoff 可设(默认 0.7)，老年建议按 LLN。: The cutoff is configurable (default 0.7); LLN is advised for the elderly.
map.比值低且 FVC 低为混合性，需 TLC/DLCO 确认。: Low ratio plus low FVC is mixed; confirm with TLC/DLCO.
map.肺功能(FEV1/FVC)分级器，根据FEV1、FVC实测值及预计值计算FEV1: Pulmonary Function (FEV1/FVC) Grader computes the FEV1/FVC ratio from measured and predicted values, classifying obstructive/restrictive defects and GOLD grade. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.阻塞性：一秒率 < 阈值（默认 0.70；可留空用下拉，或填 0.50–0.90: Obstructive: ratio < threshold (default 0.70; leave the custom field blank to use the dropdown, or enter an LLN value 0.50-0.90 from a GLI table)
map.正常：三者均不成立且 FEV1 占预计值 ≥80%（ATS/ERS 2019 口: Normal: none of the three criteria applies and FEV1 % predicted >=80% (ATS/ERS 2019: all three parameters at or above the lower limit of normal)
map.GOLD 分级（按 FEV1 占预计值）：≥80% GOLD 1 轻度: GOLD grading (by FEV1 % predicted): >=80% GOLD 1 mild
map.≥50% GOLD 2 中度｜≥30% GOLD 3 重度｜<30% GOLD: >=50% GOLD 2 moderate | >=30% GOLD 3 severe | <30% GOLD 4 very severe
map.阻塞+限制组合时按 FEV1 分级并提示查 TLC/DLCO: When obstruction and restriction coexist, grade by FEV1 and prompt TLC/DLCO testing
map.临床建议随分级输出（戒烟/支扩剂/联合吸入/氧疗评估）: Clinical advice is output by grade (smoking cessation/bronchodilator/combination inhaler/oxygen therapy assessment)
map.请输入有效的 FEV1 与 FVC（FEV1 须大于 0 且小于 FVC）。: Enter valid FEV1 and FVC values (FEV1 must be greater than 0 and less than FVC).
map.请输入有效的 FEV1%pred 与 FVC%pred（须大于 0）。: Enter valid FEV1%pred and FVC%pred values (both must be greater than 0).
map.自定义阈值须为 0.50–0.90 之间的数字；LLN 请按 GLI/ATS-E: The custom cutoff must be between 0.50 and 0.90; take the LLN from a GLI/ATS-ERS reference table, or leave it blank to use the fixed dropdown threshold.
